about: Which files of a `pp notices` output the app carries as Licenses/ (build/notices-app.py; docs/NOTICES.md, "The app's selection"). Every collected file is either included by a component or excluded by a group with its reason; a new collected file fails selection until it is classified here. An include wins over an exclude.

answers: LLVM runtime: accepted. The llvm-mingw runtime code embedded by compiling needs no attribution under the LLVM exception (4(a), 4(b), 4(d) waived); the app carries LLVM's root licence and credit files, the source bundle the full set.
FreeType: FTL, with its credit line.

Rust: ns-keyed-archive, plist-macro and plist_ffi have no licence file upstream; the app carries notices Playport writes from their Cargo.toml (MIT; ns-keyed-archive MIT OR Apache-2.0, taken as MIT) with 'Copyright (c) Jackson Coxson' from their authors field, labelled as such. plist_ffi compiles no libplist code.

StikJIT and GStreamer: shipped with best-effort notices from matching versions (StikJIT's MPL-2.0 text and idevice's notices; GStreamer's recipe-associated set), labelled best effort on the licences page.
GStreamer's MoltenVK (Apache-2.0): its licence at the SDK's MoltenVK tag, decision 0042.
mingw-w64 Cephes: answered by Moshier's own grants.
Supersets carried whole: accepted; over-inclusion cannot miss a notice.
Madeira: its un-headered build/*-unix files are taken under the stricter reading, GPL-3.0-or-later, and its Wine commits under its published licence; no upstream request is sent.

Wine's fallback Tahoma faces (Runtime/fonts, reviewed 2026-10-05): accepted. They are Wine's tracked prebuilt TTFs at the Wine pin, shipped unmodified; each face is LGPL-2.1-or-later (its SFD name table) and derived from Bitstream Vera Sans, whose licence permits modification and redistribution with the notice, forbids the Bitstream/Vera names on modified fonts (the faces are named Wine Tahoma) and selling a face by itself (it ships inside the app). The app carries wine-COPYING.LIB.txt, the Bitstream Vera licence in wine-NOTICES.md and each face's SFD attribution lines; the SFD sources are part of the Wine pin's Corresponding Source (0042). The family name Tahoma is kept, as Wine and Linux distributions ship it, for metric-compatible substitution.

parts.app: Playport's Swift app, PlayportKit, HostIOKit and the JIT helper extension's own code
parts.SteamClient: app/SteamClient, with protocol schema tables derived from JavaSteam
parts.rust-std: the Rust standard library linked into libidevice_ffi.a (P10-idevice)
parts.llvm-mingw-runtime: llvm-mingw's libc++, libc++abi, libunwind and compiler-rt code in every PE DLL built with it
parts.mingw-crt: the mingw-w64 CRT and headers in every PE DLL built with llvm-mingw

exclude.why: collection records for audit, not notices; path-independent and kept with the full collection

the rest of the LLVM runtime source superset (code, tests, tools, other platforms): the LLVM exception waives attribution for runtime code embedded by compiling; it stays in the full collection and the source bundle
